## What changed

Describe the behavior change and its user impact.

## Root cause

For bug fixes, explain why the previous behavior was incorrect.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Go files are formatted and `go vet ./...` passes when applicable.
- [ ] Failure paths and `Success=false` results were considered.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior changed.

## Confidentiality and safety

- [ ] The change contains only generic code and synthetic fixtures.
- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, customer source, production logs, personal data, or confidential documents are included.
- [ ] SAP-facing mutations remain protected by the existing safety policy.
